evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to the same identified content; A absent.

COD.rationale: C, O and D features are present but not bound to the same attribute (content attribute 'red' vs organization attribute 'origin'), so a fully compatible COD binding is ambiguous.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation statement linking attention to a named content's organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content (color-labelled positions) and an attribute (red).

D.rationale: The report separates identified content (red positions) from its status/origin metadata, distinguishing content identification from organization/access.

O.rationale: The report states how the content is presented/accessed via explicit origin/representation metadata.
